subject: Renewal stability matrix — action items & commit refresh
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Aug 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal stability matrix — action items & commit refresh

Team —

Quick one: finance asked for a tightened renewal stability view for next week’s forecast lock. I attached the current renewal_stability_matrix.xlsx and highlighted accounts we flagged as "watch" in June. Request: please do the following by EOD Tuesday (Aug 3):

- Update stage to reflect latest customer signals (if more conservative, mark as "At Risk" and add short rationale).
- Confirm commit probability (do not auto-override system probability unless you have a commit email).
- Add any open procurement/PO blockers into column H and drop a target date.

HelixHealth (DL-18342) is a priority — procurement asked for evidence on usage and support SLA history; they sign this week -> finance needs final ARR attribution. Marissa, can you confirm whether the renewed seat count remains as proposed or if we should expect a ramp-down? Aditya, please flag any billing discrepancies you see. Naomi, if finance needs a credit memo runbook, can you prepare the stub?

I’m looping procurement contact Sara to keep the cadence tight; please keep replies short and include the matrix row id in your response.

Thanks,
Grace
Director, Renewal Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: renewal_stability_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), helix_risk_notes_2027-07-30.pdf (summary of last CS check)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal stability matrix — action items & commit refresh

Grace / all —

Thanks — I updated HelixHealth row (ID: RHX-71) to reflect latest usage conversation with Sara last Friday. Changes:
- Stage: Proposal -> Negotiation (moved to "At Risk" since one module license is under review)
- Probability: lowered from 70% -> 40% (reason: procurement has outstanding legal SOW redlines and they indicated a potential seat reduction)
- Notes: added a short summary under "sales_rationale" pointing to the PDF notes and quoted Sara's comment re: "looking to tighten spend next quarter"

I also flagged a new PO blocker (missing signature on SOW) with target date Aug 6 and added a comment with procurement contact. I did NOT change ARR yet — will wait for finance confirmation.

Marissa
Senior Account Exec
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 04 Aug 2027 13:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal stability matrix — action items & commit refresh

Marissa / Grace —

Thanks for the quick update and for including the procurement team. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- We are still evaluating one module given our Q4 budget reforecast; that could reduce active seats by up to 15% starting Oct.
- Legal provided redline suggestions on the SOW yesterday; procurement is coordinating final review.
- We can sign a 9-month term now if Redwood can commit to the current pricing and include a clause for reassessment at the 6-month mark.

I'll ask procurement to push the SOW back to your team with the consolidated redlines by EOD Thursday (Aug 5). I know your finance team needs an ARR number — please use a conservative baseline (current active seats) and add a line item for the potential 15% reduction so the forecast shows both scenarios.

Sara
Head of Procurement
HelixHealth

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 06 Aug 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal stability matrix — action items & commit refresh

Team —

Short update from my side after reviewing billing and usage:
- No outstanding invoicing issues found for HelixHealth; last three months of token billing reconcile to their reported usage (see note in Drive link).
- For forecasting clarity, I propose we create two lines for the deal in the matrix: "HelixHealth - Baseline" (current active seats) and "HelixHealth - Downside 15%" (reduced seats) so FinOps can attribute ARR and sensitivity separately.
- Naomi — can you confirm whether finance wants the downside modeled as a separate row or as an adjustment to probability? Finance typically prefers the separate-line approach for clarity on ARR movement.

If Procurement returns the SOW with redlines by Aug 5 as Sara suggested, we should have firm signal by Monday (Aug 9). For now, I'll lock the matrix with Marissa's probability and create the downside row as proposed so the forecast can show both scenarios.

Aditya
Revenue Operations Analyst
Redwood Inference
